reponse: The old way was to set FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash in .env.local and restart vite [1], but that's no longer valid: the flag was renamed dashboards_v2 and flags are now served by the API, so FEATURE_FLAGS is ignored [2]. Instead run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` to enable it for the dev workspace [2], with the API running, then hard-reload the page; you can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. The rollout plan also lists the flag as dashboards_v2 [4].
